verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a public GitHub repository, RevenueCat/purchases-ios, so the iOS SDK client source appears to be readable. However, none of the cited material states the license, and nothing indicates the backend platform (dashboard, charts, webhooks, server) is published as source. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, source availability beyond the iOS SDK (other SDKs, backend), independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
